title: Build a complete HTML document
learningObjectives: Identify and assemble the parts of a complete HTML document

understand.concept: A basic document combines doctype, html root, head metadata and body content. Indentation helps people inspect nesting but does not create structure.
understand.whyItMatters: A consistent skeleton prevents missing metadata and provides a reliable starting point.
understand.analogy: A building plan shows relationships between parts, but HTML is parsed into a document tree, not built from concrete.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is only a memory aid; HTML should not be interpreted literally through it.

explain.narrative: A basic document combines doctype, html root, head metadata and body content. Indentation helps people inspect nesting but does not create structure.
